description: Quality baseline: today's debt counts. A count only goes down and the coverage floor only goes up; raising a count or lowering the floor needs the owner. The guard named in each entry enforces it.

counts.what: warnings over src/, test/ and scripts/ (errors: 0)
counts.guard: --max-warnings 686 in the lint script; format:check runs lint
review: a new marker needs a one-line reason
record only (owner choice); npm run security blocks production high and any critical

coverage_floor.over: every source file (src/**/*.ts, no tests or .d.ts)
coverage_floor.guard: coverageThreshold in jest.config.ts; check and CI run test:coverage
